meta.title: PrivacyCulture — Know thyself
meta.description: Know thyself. Most privacy teams don’t. Privacy Culture Platform is GDPR software for mid-market UK teams — living ROPA, DSARs, DPIAs, vendor risk, and shadow AI in one connected view.

coldOpen.title: Privacy platforms have started to look the same.
paragraphs: A wall of modules. A licence fee. A shrug when the board asks the hard question.
So we started somewhere else — not “what do you need to record?” but “what do you actually need to fix?”

lens.eyebrow: Come and see the view from here
lens.title: Where clarity meets control.
lens.body: Finally see your whole privacy picture brought into focus. Book a relaxed 25-minute walk-through to explore the Visual ROPA View using real sample data, and see how our connected workflows fit your team.

principles.title: Simplicity over software clutter
principles.body: No complex onboarding, no endless configuration, and no enterprise price tags. You get clean, intuitive workflows so you can get up and running without burning months on setup.

principles.title: Visual clarity, not dense lists
principles.body: Privacy shouldn’t feel like endless scrolling through giant spreadsheets or text-heavy tables. We show your data flows, vendor ecosystem, and risks as a clear, interactive map—so you spot issues instantly instead of hunting through rows of text.

principles.title: Distributed ownership
principles.subtitle: Across the whole business
principles.body: Privacy shouldn’t be a one-person job. Pass day-to-day tasks directly to team leads in HR, Marketing, or Product, while you keep full visibility and central control from your dashboard.
